text: P5 now includes one-family actual-binary evidence: Slurm 25.05.6 parser registry, successful array acceptance, exact v0.0.43 compressed pending JSON, reproducible Dockerfile, and cross-Scala replay tests. This does not satisfy the epic gate: the disposable worker did not register, the 26.05 build was denied by the execution environment, and authenticated unprivileged-site evidence is still unavailable. P5 and therefore P6/epic remain open.
